payload.body: ST0007's design is now v0.2 at 81f72ee, with hv's rulings on v0.1's four questions applied -- review this version, not 4b246b2's. D40: no CI gate before the tag; ci.query reports the tagged commit's verdict after, and red is fixed forward by the next release. D35/D36: top-level builtin 'release <--patch|--minor|--major|vX.Y.Z>', the argument shape every fleet release command already takes, plus status/notes/check; the bump key is gone. Every key is defaulted and overridable (object: local by default, devbin overrides to ci; tag v{version}; remotes = every git remote in order). No project is a special case: Conflab and Intent adopt like Utilz and devbin (WP-08), Intentv2 alone is out. Utilz-cc question 1 now asks whether ST0019 accepts CI reported after rather than gating before.
